name: Finance, Billing & Payments
short: Recurring billing, invoicing and collections, payables, online payments, and month-end close automation that keep cash flowing.
intro: Finance teams lose days every month to re-keying invoices, chasing payments, and reconciling accounts by hand. These solutions connect billing, payments, and accounting so money moves faster, books close sooner, and leadership always knows the cash position.

solutions.name: Membership & Subscription Billing Platform
solutions.tagline: Recurring billing, dunning, and self-service plan changes that protect monthly revenue.
solutions.text: A recurring billing and membership management platform for businesses that run on subscriptions, memberships, or recurring service plans: gyms, subscription boxes, SaaS products, or membership-based clubs. The platform handles plan tiers, automated recurring billing, failed-payment retry logic, and self-service upgrade, downgrade, and cancel flows so members manage their own accounts without generating support tickets. Dunning sequences recover failed payments automatically, usage-based billing is supported for metered plans, and revenue dashboards break down MRR, churn, and lifetime value so leadership always knows where recurring revenue stands.
features: Monthly, annual, family, and usage-based pricing.
Charges run on schedule with receipts sent automatically.
Retries and reminders that recover failed payments.
Upgrade, pause, update cards, or cancel without calling.
Pause and downgrade options shown before cancellation.
MRR, churn, and lifetime value by plan.
problems: Failed payments quietly turn into lost members
Staff process plan changes by hand
Cancellations require a phone call and frustrate members
No reliable view of recurring revenue
faq: What is dunning?
Dunning is the process of recovering failed recurring payments through automatic retries, card updater services, and reminder messages asking the customer to update their payment details.
Can members manage their own subscriptions?
Yes. A self-service portal lets members upgrade, downgrade, pause, update payment methods, and cancel according to your policies.
Does it support usage-based or metered billing?
Yes. Usage can be recorded automatically and billed on top of or instead of a base plan.

solutions.name: Invoicing & Accounts Receivable Automation
solutions.tagline: Invoices out the same day, reminders on autopilot, and payments matched automatically.
solutions.text: An accounts receivable system that creates invoices from completed jobs, shipped orders, or billable time, sends them immediately with online payment links, and follows up on unpaid balances with a polite, escalating reminder schedule. Payments are matched to invoices and posted to your accounting system automatically, customers can pay by card, ACH, or saved payment method, and an aging dashboard shows who owes what so your team only calls the accounts that truly need attention.
for: Service businesses invoicing after each job
B2B companies with net-30 and net-60 terms
Firms billing hourly or by milestone
features: Invoices generated from jobs, orders, or approved time.
Card and ACH payments in one click.
Friendly to firm reminders before and after the due date.
Payments matched and posted to the right invoice.
Customers can opt into automatic payment.
Overdue balances and collection priorities at a glance.
problems: Invoices go out days or weeks after the work
Staff chase late payers by hand
Payments are posted to the wrong invoices
Cash flow is unpredictable
faq: How much faster do customers pay with automated reminders?
Most businesses see invoices paid sooner once invoices go out immediately with a payment link and reminders run on a consistent schedule, because nothing depends on someone remembering to follow up.
Will automated reminders upset customers?
Not when they are courteous and accurate. We write reminders in your voice and stop them the moment payment arrives or a dispute is noted.
Does it work with QuickBooks?
Yes. Invoices, payments, and customers sync with QuickBooks Online or Desktop, Xero, and most ERPs.

solutions.name: Accounts Payable & Expense Management
solutions.tagline: Bills captured, coded, approved, and paid on time without paper or re-keying.
solutions.text: A payables and expense system that captures vendor bills from email, reads them with AI document extraction, codes them to the right accounts, and routes them for approval before scheduling payment. Employee expenses are submitted from a phone with receipt photos and checked against policy, corporate card transactions are reconciled automatically, and every approval is logged for audit. Finance gets a clear view of upcoming obligations, and vendors are paid on time without late fees or duplicate payments.
for: Companies processing dozens to thousands of bills a month
Teams with employees spending on company cards
Businesses that need audit-ready approval trails
features: Invoices forwarded to one address are read automatically.
Vendor, amounts, and GL codes filled in for review.
Routing by amount, department, or project.
ACH, check, and card payments timed to terms.
Receipt photos matched to card transactions.
Alerts on duplicate invoices and bank detail changes.
problems: Bills are keyed in by hand
Approvals stall in email threads
Late fees and missed early-pay discounts
Expense reports take hours each month
faq: Can AI read our vendor invoices accurately?
Modern document AI extracts vendor, dates, amounts, and line items with high accuracy, and anything below a confidence threshold is flagged for a quick human check before posting.
How do approvals work?
Rules route each bill to the right approver based on amount, vendor, department, or project, with reminders and escalation if it sits too long.
Does this help prevent payment fraud?
Yes. Duplicate invoice detection, vendor bank detail change alerts, and separation of duties reduce common payables fraud risks.

solutions.name: Online Payments & Checkout Integration
solutions.tagline: Take card, ACH, and wallet payments anywhere, with every transaction synced to your books.
solutions.text: A payments setup that lets customers pay the way they prefer, online, in person, by text link, or on recurring autopay, with every transaction flowing cleanly into your accounting and CRM. We select and configure the right processor, build secure checkout into your website, invoices, and booking flows, set up text-to-pay and saved payment methods, and automate payout reconciliation so fees, refunds, and deposits match your bank statements without manual work.
for: Businesses still taking payments over the phone
Companies with several disconnected payment tools
Teams spending hours reconciling processor payouts
features: The right fit for your volume, industry, and fees.
Customers pay from a text in seconds.
Tokenized payment methods for repeat billing.
Fees, refunds, and deposits matched to the bank.
Card data handled by the processor, never stored by you.
problems: Taking card numbers over the phone
Deposits that do not match sales reports
Several payment apps that do not talk to each other
High processing fees nobody has reviewed
faq: Is it safe to take payments on our website?
Yes, when card data is handled by a PCI-compliant processor through hosted fields or checkout pages, so sensitive card numbers never touch your servers.
What is text-to-pay?
A secure payment link sent by SMS. Customers tap it, pay with a card or wallet, and the payment is recorded against their invoice automatically.
Can you help lower our processing fees?
We review your volume and mix of transactions and recommend processor and pricing options, including ACH for larger invoices.

solutions.name: Month-End Close & Reconciliation Automation
solutions.tagline: Close the books in days, not weeks, with automated reconciliations and checklists.
solutions.text: A close management system that turns month-end from a scramble into a checklist. Bank and card transactions are reconciled automatically against your ledger, recurring journal entries and accruals are posted on schedule, intercompany and clearing accounts are matched, and exceptions are routed to the right person with supporting documents attached. A close checklist tracks every task, owner, and due date, and management reports are generated and delivered as soon as the books are final.
for: Finance teams taking two weeks or more to close
Owners who want timely monthly financials
features: Transactions matched to the ledger with rules and AI.
Tasks, owners, dependencies, and due dates tracked.
Unmatched items sent to the right reviewer with context.
P&L, balance sheet, and KPIs delivered at close.
problems: Closing the books takes most of the following month
Reconciliations live in fragile spreadsheets
Leadership makes decisions on outdated numbers
Audit prep means hunting for support documents
faq: How long should a month-end close take?
Many small and midsize businesses aim for five to ten business days. Automating reconciliations and recurring entries is usually the biggest lever for getting there.
Can reconciliations be fully automated?
Most matching can be automated with rules and AI. A person still reviews exceptions and signs off, which keeps controls intact.
Does this work with our accountant or bookkeeper?
Yes. External accountants can work inside the same checklist and reconciliation tools, which usually speeds up their work too.
